actions.create_and_push_to_campaign.desc: Create a new contact (or update an existing one) and immediately enrol them in a campaign so they start receiving outreach emails.
actions.create_and_push_to_campaign.prop: City the contact is based in.
The company or organisation the contact works for.
Country the contact is based in.
The contact's email address. Used to identify and deduplicate contacts.
Full URL to the contact's LinkedIn profile, e.g. https://linkedin.com/in/janedoe
Internal notes about this contact. Not visible to the contact.
State or province the contact is based in.
IANA time zone name used to schedule emails at the right local time, e.g. "America/New_York" or "Europe/London".
Contact's job title, e.g. "VP of Sales" or "Marketing Manager".
actions.create_or_update_contact.descrip: Add a new contact to Reply.io, or update their details if a contact with that email already exists.
actions.create_or_update_contact.props.c: City the contact is based in.
The company or organisation the contact works for.
Country the contact is based in.
actions.create_or_update_contact.props.e: The contact's email address. Used to identify and deduplicate contacts.
actions.create_or_update_contact.props.l: Full URL to the contact's LinkedIn profile, e.g. https://linkedin.com/in/janedoe
actions.create_or_update_contact.props.s: State or province the contact is based in.
actions.create_or_update_contact.props.t: IANA time zone name used to schedule emails at the right local time, e.g. "America/New_York" or "Europe/London".
Contact's job title, e.g. "VP of Sales" or "Marketing Manager".
actions.custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
actions.custom_api_call.props.failsafe.d: On a failed request, output the error instead of failing the step.
actions.custom_api_call.props.followRedi: Follow 3xx redirects instead of returning them as the response.
actions.custom_api_call.props.headers.de: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.
actions.custom_api_call.props.response_i: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.
actions.custom_api_call.props.timeout.de: Seconds to wait for a response. Empty: up to the flow limit (10 min).
actions.delete_contact.description: Permanently delete a contact from Reply.io by their email address. This cannot be undone.
actions.delete_contact.props.email.descr: Email address of the contact to permanently delete.
actions.get_contact.description: Look up a contact in Reply.io by their email address and retrieve their details.
actions.get_contact.props.email.descript: Email address of the contact to look up.
actions.mark_finished.description: Mark a contact as finished so they no longer receive emails in any campaign. Use this when you have completed all outreach to that contact.
actions.mark_finished.props.email.descri: Email address of the contact to mark as finished.
actions.mark_replied.description: Record that a contact has replied to your outreach. This stops further follow-up emails to that contact across all active campaigns.
actions.mark_replied.props.email.descrip: Email address of the contact to mark as replied.
actions.push_to_campaign.description: Enrol an existing contact in a campaign so they start receiving outreach emails. Enable "Force Push" to move the contact even if they are already active in another campaign.
actions.push_to_campaign.props.email.des: Email address of the contact to add to the campaign.
actions.push_to_campaign.props.forcePush: Move the contact into this campaign even if they are already active in another campaign. Leave off to skip contacts already in an active campaign.
actions.remove_from_all_campaigns.descri: Remove a contact from every campaign they are enrolled in. No further emails will be sent to them. Their contact record is kept in Reply.io.
Email address of the contact to remove from all campaigns.
actions.remove_from_campaign.description: Stop a contact from receiving further emails in a specific campaign. The contact's record is kept in Reply.io.
actions.remove_from_campaign.props.email: Email address of the contact to remove from the campaign.
auth.description: Your Reply.io API key. Find it in Reply.io under **Settings → API**.
description: Sales engagement platform for contacts, campaigns, and outbound outreach workflows.
